registry_info.name: dark_spot
registry_info.description: The workshop's answer (see /the-dark-spot). The dark spot is not passive — it is the CATALYST. dark_sphere is the situated witness in 748 rooms (Haraway's partial witness); attended, the witness becomes catalyst (capability-as-relation, making kin, felt not measured — the anti-harmony-meter). grey_point is the hinge: the instant the witness becomes. Artifacts here register their own capture (situated, complicit), not a pure outside.
registry_info.note: grey_point declines a critical_parameter as DEFERRAL, not pure refusal — un-still-able like catalyst_orb (exists only in the gesture). Do NOT promote, sweep, capture, or 'fix' its harmony: it keeps difference hot on purpose. The irreducible is temporal (finite attention) and ACTIVE — what cannot be reconciled is what keeps the system becoming.

grey_point.name: grey_point — the form the pipeline cannot register
grey_point.description: Klee's non-dimensional origin, 'between becoming and passing'. A point that will not resolve — breathing between rendered and unrendered so any still catches it mid-transition, refusing to commit to a size, drifting off-centre without landing. Deliberately excluded from the DNA sweep, the galleries, and the harmony meter. The dark spot, made an object.
